messages:
Ari: Heads-up — q4b-int4 bringup caused 2x label queue surge, lots of near-duplicates + golden rejects. Can we throttle ingest and enable turnstile gating? :eyes:
Devin: Where are duplicates coming from? tokenizer change? any diffs vs q6b?
Cassie: Yup tokenizer mapping changed; many paraphrase near-dupes and truncated prompts. Quick stats:
```
new_ingest: 9,842
dedupe_rate: 27%
golden_fail_rate: 14%
avg_review_time: 3.6m
```
Cassie: Most fails are short prompts that got split, feeding into sampler mismatch. Recommending immediate dedupe pass + microgolden gating.
Chandra: We can flip labelflow turnstile to microgolden-only for new annotators: `labelflow set-turnstile --mode microgolden --min-passed 3` — that'll stop fresh annotators from touching batches until they pass.
Sam: What's ETA to clear backlog if we throttle ingest and run dedupe? Need SLOs for downstream eval runs.
Ari: Plan: 1) throttle ingest to 30% for 24h; 2) run dedupe job (priority) on queue; 3) enable turnstile command (Chandra), 4) reassign high-confidence automation to "fast-review" tag. Expect backlog down ~72h. I'll notify CS and evals. :thumbsup:
label-bot: assigned 4,120 items to queue-fast-review (batch-id: br-202304)
Devin: OK — assign temp reviewers for the next 48h, Sam help me with capacity pls.
Sam: On it, pinged ops for 6 temp reviewers. ETA 2h.
Cassie: I'll prepare golden update: add 120 microgolden items covering tokenizer edgecases.
Ari: Thanks all — keep thread updated with any regressions. If golden_fail_rate climbs >20% we roll back quant-inference. :warning:
